Name: Auto Feeding
Author: JellyQuarters
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]It is what it says. It removes the need to feed yourself, eliminating that annoying 3-4 second interruption to your otherwise [/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]✨ [/color][color=#d4d4d8]ｈｉｇｈｌｙ  ｅｆｆｉｃｉｅｎｔ  ｗｏｒｋｆｌｏｗ [/color][color=#d4d4d8] ✨[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Extract into Mods or just use Vortex. Either way works. [/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Because I'm not a professional, I couldn't come up with a better solution than using GMCM to set things up. You'll have to get the food/drink ID and put them into the configuration. That's it. You can find these somewhere on the internet, it truly isn't difficult. (That being said, I haven't done extensive ([i]any[/i]) testing with item IDs that aren't food or drinks and have no idea how the mod will react to something like that. Good luck and Godspeed if curiosity gets the better of you.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]The only thing you technically need is SMAPI, but unless you enjoy manually configuring config JSON files, you should probably have GMCM as well. [/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to my mama for raising a real one.[/color][/size]

Downloads.Description: Really simple mod that shouldn't require any updates (says the unfortunate developer unaware of an oncoming disaster)

Manifest.Name: Auto Feed
Manifest.Description: Automatically eats a configured food/drink when its buff wears off.
